description.text: The second expansion pack of the Pokémon Card ★neo series, released in Japan on 7 July 2000. Its theme is the Ruins of Alph, and with it come the Unown, each shaped like a different letter. Some familiar Pokémon change type here, such as a Water Kabuto and a Fighting Poliwrath, and Dark Raichu, first printed in English, is the set's secret card. Its English counterpart is Neo Discovery, released in June 2001.
